study_identification_part.si_4_title: Beyond homogeneity: charting the landscape of heterogeneity in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric electroencephalography

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) were used for normative modeling. The models employed fractional polynomials for the age covariate and various distribution families (SEP4, SEP2, GB2, SEP1, exGAUS for spectral features; BCPE, ST3, SEP2 for connectivity features) selected empirically based on BIC scores.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: trained a Generalized Additive Model for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) on the training set; In this study, our response variable is an EEG-derived feature and the main covariate is age. Bethlehem et al. use fractional polynomials as the smoothing function to account for nonlinearity without adding instability to their models, and we adopt the same approach.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Two EEG-derived features were modeled: (1) Relative power spectral density (PSD) computed using Welch's method for each channel across five frequency bands (delta [1-4 Hz], theta [4-8 Hz], alpha [8-13 Hz], beta [13-30 Hz], gamma [30-45 Hz]); (2) Amplitude Envelope Correlation (AEC) functional connectivity between 68 brain regions from the Desikan-Killiany atlas, computed using the HD-EEG source connectivity method with eLORETA source reconstruction.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: For the spectral features, a GAMLSS was fitted to the relative power (Welch's method) of each channel and each frequency band. Functional connectivity was estimated between 68 predefined brain regions from the Desikan-Killiany atlas using Amplitude Envelope Correlation -AEC-

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age was modeled using fractional polynomials (fp(age, 1) or fp(age, 2)) to capture nonlinear age effects. Site was included as a fixed effect in spectral models for theta, alpha, and beta bands. Sex was included in the connectivity model for the alpha band. The final model specifications varied by feature type and frequency band, with covariates selected empirically based on BIC comparison.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In this study, our response variable is an EEG-derived feature and the main covariate is age. The selection of model covariates beyond age (sex, and site/study as both a fixed effect and a random effect) is performed empirically.
